messages.subject: Garnett on VISIUM
messages.body_plain:
Dear Garnett team,

Thank you for generating Garnett. I have used it in multiple occasions to solve questions!

May I know if this model can be used to predict cell types on VISIUM dataset which might have multiple cell types each pixel?

Best,
Justine
